main_text.head: MONARCHIÆ ROMANÆ INDIVULSÆ
LIBER IV. De
QUARTA ROMANI IMPERII PERIODO AB HERACLIO AD CAROLUM MAGNUM.
main_text.p: Anni sunt 190. ab A. C. 611. ad Annum 801.
main_text.head: CAPUT I. DE HERACLIO.
main_text.p: Es ab HERACLIO gestas tribus periodis egor. Tercommode includemus. Prima, quæ ad Arcenius expeditionis Perficæ initia duravit duraZonaras vit, plena perplexitatis erat. Persæ enim Tom. 3. imperiu Romanarum provinciarum sub Phoca devastatione illecti, & Heraclium imperatum, scientes, arma deponere volebant. Hinc factum ut *Armenia & Cappadocia, Cæsareâ expugnatâ, in potestatem Cosrhois devenerunt. Saraceni in Syria † prædas agerent, Damascus* caperetur, & missi ab Heraclio legati, fine relpor.so dimit-te-rentur. Hierosolymâ captâ, ad XCM hominum a Judæis, vili precio sanguinem Christianorum.

page.notes: The scan is faint and several marginal notes are partly illegible; the Greek-free text contains marked uncertain readings (e.g. "Tercommode", "Arcenius", "relpor.so", "XCM") that are best checked against the original. Some footnote marks are unclear. The printed line "Yy 3" is a gathering signature, not a catchword; the bottom word "com-" is the catchword.
